scope: Native reproduction and repair of the play queue dialog activation failure
environment: Isolated Windows x64 WinUI probe under the ongoing authorized local UI debugging task
probeSource: The ignored local probe links the product PlaybackQueueDialog.xaml, its code-behind, and TransientPlaybackQueue.cs. It uses the product API assembly and a minimal XamlControlsResources host. No login or server connection is performed.

before.message: Failed to create a 'Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.IconElement' from the text 'Down'. [Line: 47 Position: 88]

repair: Replace string-based Up/Down icon conversions with explicit FontIcon arrow glyphs E74A and E74B. The invalid Down Symbol conversion was the failure; CommandBar content and dialog lifecycle were not the cause.

checks: Empty queue constructs, opens, displays empty content, disables unavailable actions, and closes
Two-item queue constructs, opens, and selects the first item
Native AppBarButton automation Invoke moves the selected item down and up, retaining selection and updating boundary action availability
Native Remove invocation removes the selected item
Native Clear queue invocation from the expanded command bar empties the queue and displays empty content
A subsequent empty queue dialog constructs, opens, and closes in the same process

limits: This isolated native dialog run is not a full signed-in application workflow or playback test
No screenshot-based layout, theme, large-text, or screen-reader acceptance is claimed
